description: Deployment-management tools the Agent Orchestrator uses to embed agents as chat widgets, scheduled tasks, and automatic triggers on behalf of a Basic-mode user.

manage_agent_shortcode.reason: Creates/edits/deletes a shortcode embed row — reversible, no code execution.

manage_frontend_modal_agent.reason: Toggles the site-wide floating chat widget — reversible.

manage_scheduled_task.reason: Creates a recurring task an agent runs unattended on a schedule.

manage_event_listener.reason: Creates a trigger that runs an agent unattended when a WordPress event fires.

manage_cli_settings.reason: Expands what the extreme-risk run_wp_cli tool is allowed to run, and which agents may call it.

run_wp_cli.reason: Executes WP-CLI commands directly; matches the tool's own baseline risk floor.

agents_available.reason: Read-only browsing of the community agent catalog.
